name: shoshone-shredder
description: A mountain-bike game for two brothers, set in their neighborhood.

scripts.release:setup: npx --yes wrangler@3.114.17 pages project create shoshone-shredder --production-branch main
scripts.release: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@3.114.17 pages deploy dist --project-name shoshone-shredder --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run check && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@3.114.17 pages deploy dist --project-name shoshone-shredder --branch preview
